verdict.rationale: Controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for an accounting SaaS that holds financial and payroll data, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers cloud backups and always-available data access; nothing documents retention settings, account or data deletion, or purge controls. Letting employees manage their contact details is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
